faq.headline: Questions, answered.
faq.a1: MEWS and Apaleo today, plus Gmail for the inbox — each connected in a few minutes. More integrations are on the way; tell us what you run.
faq.q2: Do I have to switch systems?
faq.a2: No. Fondas sits on top of the tools you already use. Nothing to migrate and nothing for your team to relearn.
faq.a3: About an afternoon. Connect your PMS and inbox, and your first brief can arrive the very next morning.
faq.q4: Does Fondas ever email guests without me?
faq.a4: Never automatically. Every reply is drafted for your review — sending is always your decision.
faq.q5: Where does our guest data live?
faq.a5: Each hotel's data is isolated and protected by row-level security, so one property can never see another's. PMS and inbox tokens are stored encrypted, and we request only the access we need.
faq.q6: Is guest data used to train AI models?
faq.a6: No. Your guests' information is used only to run your hotel's briefs, drafts and answers — never to train shared models.
faq.a7: One flat price per property, per month — everything included, with no per-seat fees. Get in touch and we'll get you set up.
